name: Wadi Kom Ombo Land Reclamation S.A.E.

ratios.label: Earnings per share
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the twin keys EGS01071C017 and EGS01071C017.CA are one issuer and published eps for this period (14.49 against 20.443667). Neither key is backed by the issuer's own filing, so both sides are withheld.

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (wadikomombolandreclamationsae) is served under two keys, EGS01071C017 P/E 14.5 and EGS01071C017.CA P/E 14.29, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 165.62 percent a year from FY2024 (4.311e+07) to FY2025 (1.1451e+08), over 1 year
valuation.peFormula: market capitalisation / net profit, the same ratio as price / earnings per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.pbFormula: market capitalisation / total equity, the same ratio as price / book value per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.psFormula: market capitalisation / revenue, the same ratio as price / revenue per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.peCrossCheck: differ by 6%: market cap 1540000000 used (price x shares) vs 1635984000 on file

derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 313.07) to the price on 2026-10-05
